strings.jp:

どかねぇと命がねぇぞ~!

strings.en:
Wanna fight the great me?

strings.jp:

strings.en:
A greenhorn like you
ain't beatin' me yet!

strings.jp: ぐはッ…し、死ぬほどいてぇ…

山賊の親分よ!
strings.en:
Kihihi... Serves ya right,
Brigand Boss!
